plugin.note: Ranged avoids Jad's no-warning melee and lets the player fight from distance. Twisted bow is strongest on Jad specifically because of his high Magic level.

requirements: TzHaar Slayer task with the TzTok-Jad alternative accepted.
Supplies for a complete Fight Cave run.
Ranged setup strongly recommended for wave control and Jad distance.
mechanics: The Fight Cave is a wave encounter ending with TzTok-Jad.
TzTok-Jad uses Magic and Ranged attacks that must be prayer-switched correctly.
Jad also has a melee attack without the same practical warning, so fighting from range is safer.
Healers spawn during the Jad fight and can restore Jad if left uncontrolled.
A successful task completion gives 37,010 total Slayer XP and the on-task pet-rate bonus.

methods.label: Ranged wave clear
methods.summary: Use Ranged for the Fight Cave waves so Jad can be fought from outside melee distance.
recommendedFor: players learning Fight Cave prayer rhythm
requiredOrKeyItems: Emergency teleport before entering only; leaving the cave ends the run
steps: Clear waves while preserving prayer and supplies for Jad.
Use terrain to separate dangerous wave combinations where possible.
Before Jad spawns, move to a position that keeps distance and gives clear line of sight.
Stay outside melee range and attack Jad with Ranged.
risks: Leaving or dying ends the run.
Supply mistakes on earlier waves can make Jad unsafe even with correct prayers.

methods.label: Jad prayer switching
methods.summary: Watch Jad's attack animations and alternate protection prayers for Magic and Ranged while keeping distance.
steps: Focus on Jad's attack animation before every hit.
Switch to Protect from Magic for the magic animation.
Switch to Protect from Missiles for the ranged animation.
Tag healers when they spawn, then control them without losing the prayer rhythm.
Resume attacking Jad once healers are controlled.
risks: One missed protection prayer can kill the player.
Chasing healers can drag the player into melee range.

styleOptions.label: Ranged Jad setup
styleOptions.summary: Use Ranged through the cave and on Jad to avoid his no-warning melee.
notes: Twisted bow is especially strong on Jad, while blowpipe is strong for many wave targets.
